address: Unit 3, Tower Bridge House, St Katharine Docks, London,E1W 1BA
bio: Ping Pong St Katherine Dock offers a unique twist on Afternoon Tea, with spring rolls, dim sum and black coconut ice cream bao on the menu. Enjoy the best part of the day with Afternoon Tea overlooking St Katherine Dock.  Ping Pong Afternoon Tea is available all week between 2pm and 4.30pm at St Christopher’s Place and St Katharine Docks. Indulge in a lavish selection of dim sum and petit desserts, served with your choice of rare and gourmet teas or coffee, for £20 per person.  Elevate the experience by adding a glass of prosecco for just £5, or a gin and tonic pot for £12.
